parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of the box fan, made of lightweight plastic for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, driven by an electric motor located at the center of the assembly.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around a central axis when powered, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body and housing of the box fan, made of durable ABS plastic with a handle and protective grille.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and encloses the fan blades and motor, providing structural integrity and safety for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed frame that holds all internal components.
